route_note: Take a direct local bus from Chennai (Koyambedu or Tambaram) or a taxi along the East Coast Road; buses drop you in the town centre, a short auto ride from the Shore Temple.
Take a train from Chennai Egmore or Chennai Beach toward Kanchipuram Road station, or a frequent bus from Koyambedu; temples are a short auto ride from the station or bus stand.
tour_query: Kanchipuram temples day trip from Chennai

route_note: Direct trains run from Chennai Egmore to Puducherry in about 3 to 4 hours, and frequent express buses from Koyambedu take a similar time; the French Quarter is a short walk or auto ride from the bus stand.
Take a direct train from Chennai Central or Egmore to Tirupati in about 3 hours, then a local bus or taxi up the hill to Tirumala for the main temple, which is about 25 km from the town.
